papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.desc: Compresses the KV cache at inference time by storing low-rank keys and predicting values from those keys, so long contexts use less memory without a retraining pass.

papers.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
papers.desc: An expert-checked benchmark for composing one image from many scattered references while ignoring distractors, aimed at agent-driven image generation.

papers.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
papers.desc: Makes relative-position attention exact and fast with structure-aware kernels, a RoPE alternative that has been especially strong in audio.

papers.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
papers.desc: A multimodal agent that splits circuit-board routing into a global plan and local geometric edits inside a real routing tool.

papers.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
papers.desc: Prunes language models against measured latency, throughput, and memory limits instead of asking practitioners to guess a parameter budget.

papers.title: Authorization Drift in LLM Agents: Evaluating Boundary Compliance in Multi-Step Tool Use
papers.desc: Measures agents that quietly step past their permissions while chasing a user goal, using a benchmark that pairs a compliant path with an attractive shortcut.

papers.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
papers.desc: LambdaMix trains a family of preference-conditioned policies with low-rank adapters so one model can shift objective trade-offs without a full retrain.

papers.title: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
papers.desc: Widens the residual stream that carries state through a Transformer while leaving each layer's compute width unchanged.

papers.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
papers.desc: Caches a solved reasoning trace so later instances of the same task can be executed cheaply on CPU, with the language model mostly out of the loop.

papers.title: Human-Centred, Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
papers.desc: Argues financial OCR should be scored on whether the facts a decision depends on survive, not on character error rate.

papers.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
papers.desc: A benchmark for editing another model's weights directly, without gradients, from lexical tweaks to factual updates.

papers.title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
papers.desc: Studies on-policy self-distillation for multilingual reasoning, and when a teacher conditioned on the answer stops giving useful feedback.

papers.title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
papers.desc: Lets a multimodal model choose, layer by layer, which vision features to feed into which language-model layers.

papers.title: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
papers.desc: Trains continuous dynamical systems by matching velocities instead of backpropagating through a long simulated rollout.

papers.title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
papers.desc: Shows protein-scaffold benchmarks that only check a static fold miss whether the designed protein stays stable as it moves.
